parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the bucket is a curved metal rod attached to the upper sides of the bucket, allowing it to be carried easily.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a grip for lifting and carrying the bucket, transferring the load from the bucket body to the user's hand.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to swing freely for carrying or resting.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the bucket is a cylindrical wooden container that holds liquids or solids.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main storage compartment, containing the material being carried or stored.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, providing structural support for the handle and the contents inside.
